import sqlite3

    cursor.execute("PRAGMA table_info(sheet1)")

        print("Error: No columns found in sheet1")
        conn.close()
        exit()
    
    first_col = column_names[0]
    print(f"First column name: '{first_col}'")
    print(f"Total columns: {len(column_names)}")

    query = f"SELECT * FROM sheet1"
    df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)
    
    print(f"\nTotal rows: {len(df):,}")
    
    # Group by first column
    grouped = df.groupby(first_col)
    
    print(f"\n=== Summary Statistics Grouped by '{first_col}' ===\n")
    
    # Create summary DataFrame
    summary_data = []
    
    for group_name, group_df in grouped:
        group_stats = {
            'Group': group_name,
            'Count': len(group_df),
            'Groups_Count': len(grouped)  # Total number of groups
        }
        
        # Check for unique values in other columns
        for col in column_names[1:]:  # Skip first column
            unique_vals = group_df[col].dropna().unique()
            unique_count = len(unique_vals)
            
            if unique_count > 0:
                # Store only if there are values
                group_stats[f'{col}_unique_count'] = unique_count
                
                # Show sample unique values for columns with few unique values
                if unique_count <= 5:
                    group_stats[f'{col}_unique_samples'] = ', '.join(str(v) for v in unique_vals[:5])

                    group_stats[f'{col}_unique_samples'] = ', '.join(str(v) for v in unique_vals[:3]) + f'... (+{unique_count-3} more)'
        
        summary_data.append(group_stats)
    
    # Convert to DataFrame for nice display
    summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_data)
    
    # Print summary
    print(f"Number of unique groups in '{first_col}': {len(grouped)}\n")
    
    # Print counts for each group
    print("Counts by group:")
    count_series = df[first_col].value_counts().sort_index()
    for group, count in count_series.items():
        print(f"  {group}: {count:,} rows ({count/len(df)*100:.1f}%)")
    
    print(f"\nDetailed group information (first 10 groups):")
    
    # Display first 10 groups with their details
    for i, (group_name, group_df) in enumerate(list(grouped)[:10]):
        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"Group {i+1}: {group_name}")
        print(f"{'='*60}")
        print(f"Row count: {len(group_df):,}")
        
        # Analyze each column
        for col in column_names[1:]:  # Skip grouping column
            col_data = group_df[col].dropna()
            if len(col_data) > 0:
                unique_count = col_data.nunique()
                print(f"\n  Column '{col}':")
                print(f"    Non-null values: {len(col_data):,}")
                print(f"    Unique values: {unique_count:,}")
                
                if unique_count <= 10:
                    unique_vals = col_data.unique()
                    print(f"    Unique values: {', '.join(str(v) for v in unique_vals[:10])}")
                elif unique_count > 10:
                    # Show most common values
                    most_common = col_data.value_counts().head(5)
                    print(f"    Top 5 values:")
                    for val, count in most_common.items():
                        print(f"      - {val}: {count:,}")
    
    # Overall statistics
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print("OVERALL DATASET STATISTICS:")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    print(f"Total rows: {len(df):,}")
    print(f"Total columns: {len(column_names)}")
    print(f"Columns: {', '.join(column_names)}")
    
    # Column-wise statistics
    print(f"\nColumn details:")
    for col in column_names:
        print(f"\n  {col}:")
        print(f"    Non-null count: {df[col].count():,}")
        print(f"    Null count: {df[col].isna().sum():,}")
        print(f"    Unique values: {df[col].nunique():,}")
        
        if df[col].dtype != 'object':  # Numeric column
            print(f"    Min: {df[col].min():.2f}")
            print(f"    Max: {df[col].max():.2f}")
            print(f"    Mean: {df[col].mean():.2f}")
            print(f"    Std: {df[col].std():.2f}")
    
    conn.close()
    
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

    traceback.print_exc()

import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
from collections import Counter

db_path = './dacomp-007.sqlite'

    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    
    # Get column names
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("PRAGMA table_info(sheet1)")
    columns_info = cursor.fetchall()
    column_names = [col[1] for col in columns_info]
    
    if not column_names:
        print("Error: No columns found in sheet1")
        conn.close()
        exit()
    
    first_col = column_names[0]
    print(f"First column name: '{first_col}'")
    print(f"Total columns: {len(column_names)}")
    
    # Load data into pandas for easier analysis
    query = f"SELECT * FROM sheet1"
    df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)
    
    print(f"\nTotal rows: {len(df):,}")
    
    # Group by first column
    grouped = df.groupby(first_col)
    
    print(f"\n=== Summary Statistics Grouped by '{first_col}' ===\n")
    
    # Create summary DataFrame
    summary_data = []
    
    for group_name, group_df in grouped:
        group_stats = {
            'Group': group_name,
            'Count': len(group_df),
            'Groups_Count': len(grouped)  # Total number of groups
        }
        
        # Check for unique values in other columns
        for col in column_names[1:]:  # Skip first column
            unique_vals = group_df[col].dropna().unique()
            unique_count = len(unique_vals)
            
            if unique_count > 0:
                # Store only if there are values
                group_stats[f'{col}_unique_count'] = unique_count
                
                # Show sample unique values for columns with few unique values
                if unique_count <= 5:
                    group_stats[f'{col}_unique_samples'] = ', '.join(str(v) for v in unique_vals[:5])
                elif unique_count <= 20:
                    # For moderate number of unique values, show first 3
                    group_stats[f'{col}_unique_samples'] = ', '.join(str(v) for v in unique_vals[:3]) + f'... (+{unique_count-3} more)'
        
        summary_data.append(group_stats)
    
    # Convert to DataFrame for nice display
    summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_data)
    
    # Print summary
    print(f"Number of unique groups in '{first_col}': {len(grouped)}\n")
    
    # Print counts for each group
    print("Counts by group:")
    count_series = df[first_col].value_counts().sort_index()
    for group, count in count_series.items():
        print(f"  {group}: {count:,} rows ({count/len(df)*100:.1f}%)")
    
    print(f"\nDetailed group information (first 10 groups):")
    
    # Display first 10 groups with their details
    for i, (group_name, group_df) in enumerate(list(grouped)[:10]):
        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"Group {i+1}: {group_name}")
        print(f"{'='*60}")
        print(f"Row count: {len(group_df):,}")
        
        # Analyze each column
        for col in column_names[1:]:  # Skip grouping column
            col_data = group_df[col].dropna()
            if len(col_data) > 0:
                unique_count = col_data.nunique()
                print(f"\n  Column '{col}':")
                print(f"    Non-null values: {len(col_data):,}")
                print(f"    Unique values: {unique_count:,}")
                
                if unique_count <= 10:
                    unique_vals = col_data.unique()
                    print(f"    Unique values: {', '.join(str(v) for v in unique_vals[:10])}")
                elif unique_count > 10:
                    # Show most common values
                    most_common = col_data.value_counts().head(5)
                    print(f"    Top 5 values:")
                    for val, count in most_common.items():
                        print(f"      - {val}: {count:,}")
    
    # Overall statistics
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print("OVERALL DATASET STATISTICS:")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    print(f"Total rows: {len(df):,}")
    print(f"Total columns: {len(column_names)}")
    print(f"Columns: {', '.join(column_names)}")
    
    # Column-wise statistics
    print(f"\nColumn details:")
    for col in column_names:
        print(f"\n  {col}:")
        print(f"    Non-null count: {df[col].count():,}")
        print(f"    Null count: {df[col].isna().sum():,}")
        print(f"    Unique values: {df[col].nunique():,}")
        
        if df[col].dtype != 'object':  # Numeric column
            print(f"    Min: {df[col].min():.2f}")
            print(f"    Max: {df[col].max():.2f}")
            print(f"    Mean: {df[col].mean():.2f}")
            print(f"    Std: {df[col].std():.2f}")
    
    conn.close()
    
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()

    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    
    # Get the column names for sheet1
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("PRAGMA table_info(sheet1)")
    columns_info = cursor.fetchall()
    
    column_names = [col[1] for col in columns_info]
    print("Column names in sheet1:")
    for i, name in enumerate(column_names):
        print(f"  {i+1}. {name}")
    
    # Get data types for first few rows
    print("\nChecking data types and sample values:")
    cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM sheet1 LIMIT 10")
    sample_data = cursor.fetchall()
    
    for i, row in enumerate(sample_data):
        print(f"\nRow {i+1}:")
        for j, (col_name, value) in enumerate(zip(column_names, row)):
            if j == 0:  # First column
                print(f"  {col_name}: {value} (type: {type(value).__name__})")
    
    # Check distinct values in first column
    first_col_name = column_names[0] if column_names else None
    if first_col_name:
        cursor.execute(f"SELECT DISTINCT {first_col_name} FROM sheet1 LIMIT 20")
        distinct_values = cursor.fetchall()
        print(f"\nFirst 20 distinct values in '{first_col_name}':")
        for val in distinct_values:
            print(f"  - {val[0]}")
        
        # Count distinct values
        cursor.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT {first_col_name}) FROM sheet1")
        distinct_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
        print(f"\nTotal distinct values in '{first_col_name}': {distinct_count}")
    
    conn.close()
    
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

# filename: generate_summary.py
import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
from collections import Counter

db_path = './dacomp-007.sqlite'

try:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    
    # Get column names
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("PRAGMA table_info(sheet1)")
    columns_info = cursor.fetchall()
    column_names = [col[1] for col in columns_info]
    
    if not column_names:
        print("Error: No columns found in sheet1")
        conn.close()
        exit()
    
    first_col = column_names[0]
    print(f"First column name: '{first_col}'")
    print(f"Total columns: {len(column_names)}")
    
    # Load data into pandas for easier analysis
    query = f"SELECT * FROM sheet1"
    df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)
    
    print(f"\nTotal rows: {len(df):,}")
    
    # Group by first column
    grouped = df.groupby(first_col)
    
    print(f"\n=== Summary Statistics Grouped by '{first_col}' ===\n")
    
    # Create summary DataFrame
    summary_data = []
    
    for group_name, group_df in grouped:
        group_stats = {
            'Group': group_name,
            'Count': len(group_df),
            'Groups_Count': len(grouped)  # Total number of groups
        }
        
        # Check for unique values in other columns
        for col in column_names[1:]:  # Skip first column
            unique_vals = group_df[col].dropna().unique()
            unique_count = len(unique_vals)
            
            if unique_count > 0:
                # Store only if there are values
                group_stats[f'{col}_unique_count'] = unique_count
                
                # Show sample unique values for columns with few unique values
                if unique_count <= 5:
                    group_stats[f'{col}_unique_samples'] = ', '.join(str(v) for v in unique_vals[:5])
                elif unique_count <= 20:
                    # For moderate number of unique values, show first 3
                    group_stats[f'{col}_unique_samples'] = ', '.join(str(v) for v in unique_vals[:3]) + f'... (+{unique_count-3} more)'
        
        summary_data.append(group_stats)
    
    # Convert to DataFrame for nice display
    summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_data)
    
    # Print summary
    print(f"Number of unique groups in '{first_col}': {len(grouped)}\n")
    
    # Print counts for each group
    print("Counts by group:")
    count_series = df[first_col].value_counts().sort_index()
    for group, count in count_series.items():
        print(f"  {group}: {count:,} rows ({count/len(df)*100:.1f}%)")
    
    print(f"\nDetailed group information (first 10 groups):")
    
    # Display first 10 groups with their details
    for i, (group_name, group_df) in enumerate(list(grouped)[:10]):
        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"Group {i+1}: {group_name}")
        print(f"{'='*60}")
        print(f"Row count: {len(group_df):,}")
        
        # Analyze each column
        for col in column_names[1:]:  # Skip grouping column
            col_data = group_df[col].dropna()
            if len(col_data) > 0:
                unique_count = col_data.nunique()
                print(f"\n  Column '{col}':")
                print(f"    Non-null values: {len(col_data):,}")
                print(f"    Unique values: {unique_count:,}")
                
                if unique_count <= 10:
                    unique_vals = col_data.unique()
                    print(f"    Unique values: {', '.join(str(v) for v in unique_vals[:10])}")
                elif unique_count > 10:
                    # Show most common values
                    most_common = col_data.value_counts().head(5)
                    print(f"    Top 5 values:")
                    for val, count in most_common.items():
                        print(f"      - {val}: {count:,}")
    
    # Overall statistics
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print("OVERALL DATASET STATISTICS:")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    print(f"Total rows: {len(df):,}")
    print(f"Total columns: {len(column_names)}")
    print(f"Columns: {', '.join(column_names)}")
    
    # Column-wise statistics
    print(f"\nColumn details:")
    for col in column_names:
        print(f"\n  {col}:")
        print(f"    Non-null count: {df[col].count():,}")
        print(f"    Null count: {df[col].isna().sum():,}")
        print(f"    Unique values: {df[col].nunique():,}")
        
        if df[col].dtype != 'object':  # Numeric column
            print(f"    Min: {df[col].min():.2f}")
            print(f"    Max: {df[col].max():.2f}")
            print(f"    Mean: {df[col].mean():.2f}")
            print(f"    Std: {df[col].std():.2f}")
    
    conn.close()
    
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
